svg.title: FXLoop's CSS inspector: DevTools for your running JavaFX app
svg.desc: On the FXLoop bar over your JavaFX app's title bar you click Open CSS inspector, and the inspector opens in your browser. You pick the grey Save button. The inspector shows why it is grey: a setStyle() call in code beats the .primary rule in app.css line 42. You add an override, and the inspector suggests scopes with how many nodes each one hits: only this node, the 2 .primary buttons, or all 5 buttons. You choose .primary, and Save turns blue in the app at once. Apply to file writes the change into the existing .primary rule in app.css. On the Computed tab you force :hover on the button and see which values change and which rule sets them. The Layout tab shows its bounds, box model, parent constraints, and that its preferred width is set in form.fxml line 41.

g.text: Pick a node in your app

text.tspan: One click on the FXLoop bar opens it in your browser.
Click any control in your running app.
A setStyle() in your code beats your app.css rule.
Choose a scope: it shows how many nodes each one hits.
The fix goes into the rule already in your app.css.
Hold :hover or :pressed, and see what changes and why.
Its size, padding and parent rules, with where each is set.

svg.text: Like browser DevTools, for your running JavaFX app.
